verdict.rationale: Zero is an AI email client with MCP tools that can send and delete mail, so a sandbox or test mode is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence shows no such documented feature. Local dev servers, a devcontainer, Drizzle Studio and self-hosting are developer and contributor building blocks, not a product sandbox. The self-hosted app still connects to real Gmail via OAuth, so these setups do not isolate testing from production mailbox data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
